name: New Year Cookie Box
description: A compact Chinese New Year box for visiting family and friends. Three kinds of festive cookies and a tin of loose-leaf tea, packed in a keepsake box with a greeting card.

name: Mandarin Basket
description: Mandarin oranges are a traditional symbol of good fortune during Chinese New Year. This basket pairs hand-selected mandarins with festive snacks and a greeting card, ready to present at the door.

name: Reunion Tea Box
description: Built around tea for the reunion table: pressed pu'er tea, a pair of porcelain cups and festive sweets. Choose the gift box with red wine to add a bottle to the box.

name: Prosperity Box
description: A generous Chinese New Year box for close family and valued clients. Festive delicacies, tea and fresh mandarins, with the option to add champagne or single malt whisky.

name: Grand Prosperity Hamper
description: Our most complete Chinese New Year hamper, intended for senior clients and family elders. It brings together premium delicacies, tea, fresh fruit and a bottle of cognac.

name: Raya Dates Box

name: Raya Open House Hamper
description: A fuller Hari Raya hamper to share at the open house: dates, festive cookies, dried fruit and tea. This hamper contains no alcohol.

name: Mooncake Box
description: Four baked mooncakes in lotus and red bean paste, paired with a tin of tea. Available during the Mid-Autumn season.

name: Mid-Autumn Tea Pairing
description: Snow-skin and baked mooncakes with a ceramic cup and two teas. Available during the Mid-Autumn season.

name: Dragon Boat Dumpling Box
description: Hand-wrapped rice dumplings with savoury and sweet fillings, packed for the Dragon Boat Festival.

name: Tea Ceremony Set

name: Leather Journal
